issues.legal_issue: A decree of the trial court for specific performance merges into the decree of the appellate court, which becomes the sole operative and executable decree.

A judgment debtor may not obtain rescission under Section 28 of the Specific Relief Act solely because the decree holder did not deposit the balance sale consideration within the period fixed by the original decree when that decree merged into an appellate decree that fixed no deposit period.

The court retains discretion under Section 28 of the Specific Relief Act to extend the time for compliance with a specific-performance decree, considering the circumstances and conduct of the parties.
